text:
maya: Quick proposal — tighten onboarding quality gate signals for new model bring-ups (esp quantized variants).
aj: +1. Separate smoke (fast) vs full eval runs.
liam: Smoke run: <60s, pass criteria: <=2% hallucination on topical QA set, embedding drift <0.05 cosine, no high severity toxic outputs.
maya: Proposed smoke steps:
  1) sanity_prompt_set (50 queries)
  2) perf_check (p95 latency target)
  3) sampling & fluency spot-check (20 samples)
  4) automated toxicity check
maya: example thresholds:
```
{"smoke_min_pass":45,"hallucination_pct_max":2.0,"embed_drift_max":0.05,"p95_latency_ms":250}
```
aj: For quantized builds (int8) allow quality delta <=2.5% relative to fp16 baseline and expect latency gain >=30%.
priyaa: We should add regression policies: marginal fail => hold + manual triage; hard fail => block rollout + auto-fallback.
eval-bot: Eval run summary (smoke_set_2026-03-01): pass_count=45/50, hallucination=3.2%, embed_drift=0.047, p95_latency=180ms, toxicity_hits=0
liam: Hallucination 3.2% > 2% -> marginal fail.
maya: Question — marginal fail: immediate block or hold? I prefer hold + owner triage for new families.
aj: Policy proposal: marginal fail -> hold, assign owner within 24h, run full eval with enhanced prompts; hard fail -> block and fallback.
infra-bot: Reminder — canary config will auto-fallback to baseline model on hard fail. Ensure rollout playbook reference in PR.
priyaa: I'll draft a concise gate-checklist with checkbox items and add PR to onboarding-playbook.
maya: Add per-prompt failure logging, deterministic seeds for sampling (3 seeds) and reproducible RNG in eval harness.
liam: Also require comparison vs the last shipped model on a small leaderboard of critical prompts.
aj: :thumbsup: I'll update the gating doc and push a PR. tagging follow-ups in the triage board.
maya: Thanks all — syncing this in the ML triage tomorrow. cc @priyaa @aj
